comparisons.peer_topic: Credit Card Portfolio Composition and Growth
comparisons.peer_summary: At December 31, 2024, 96% of the credit card portfolio was managed in Consumer Banking, and total outstandings increased $1.4 billion to $103.6 billion, primarily driven by higher purchase volumes.
comparisons.comparison: While Citi is actively expanding its credit card ecosystem through strategic partnerships and portfolio acquisitions (American Airlines), BAC reports on the composition and growth of its existing portfolio. Both operate in the credit card space, but Citi's disclosure highlights a major M&A-style partnership and consolidation of co-branded cards, whereas BAC's disclosure focuses on the internal distribution and volume growth of its managed portfolio.

sentences.text: In December 2024, Citi announced a 10-year extension and expansion of its co-branded credit card partnership with American Airlines.
With the acquisition of the Barclays portfolio, Citi will become American Airlines' exclusive credit card issuing partner in 2026.
At December 31, 2024, 96 percent of the credit card portfolio was managed in Consumer Banking with the remainder in GWIM.
Outstandings in the credit card portfolio increased $1.4 billion during 2024 to $103.6 billion, primarily driven by higher purchase volumes.

comparisons.peer_summary: Provision for credit losses increased to $1.54 billion in 2024 from $1.14 billion in 2023, primarily driven by net charge-offs in the credit card portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Citi's strategy involves acquiring the Barclays American Airlines card portfolio to become an exclusive partner, implying significant balance sheet expansion or consolidation in its credit card business. GS provides context on the financial impact of its credit card portfolio via provisions, noting that 2024 provisions were driven by net charge-offs in the credit card portfolio. Both disclosures relate to the credit card business line, but Citi focuses on the structural partnership/acquisition strategy while GS focuses on the credit loss provisioning resulting from that portfolio's performance.

sentences.text: In addition, Citi reached an agreement to acquire the Barclays American Airlines co-branded card portfolio and will begin transitioning cardmembers to the Citi portfolio in 2026.
With the acquisition of the Barclays portfolio, Citi will become American Airlines' exclusive credit card issuing partner in 2026.
Provisions for 2024 reflected net provisions related to the credit card portfolio (primarily driven by net charge-offs).

comparisons.peer_topic: Consumer Credit Portfolio Composition and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm's retained consumer portfolio primarily serves the prime segment and consists of residential real estate, credit card, scored auto, and business banking loans. Originated mortgages are typically securitized or sold, while other consumer loans are retained on the balance sheet.
comparisons.comparison: Citi and JPM both identify credit cards as a core component of their consumer lending strategies. Citi is executing a major strategic shift to consolidate co-branded cards via the American Airlines partnership and Barclays acquisition. JPM describes its retained consumer portfolio strategy, which includes credit card loans, focusing on serving the prime segment. The key difference is Citi's active consolidation of external partner portfolios versus JPM's description of its existing retained portfolio composition.
